description:
The list of segments involved in the session. Read-only. Nullable.

TIP: Lists segments within a call session. Each segment has media streams with detailed quality metrics: jitter, packetLoss, roundTripTime, averageAudioDegradation, etc.

excludeResponse.description: Exclude the full response body and only return success or failure
